resources.string: Create or import a workflow, bind this phone, and validate it before enabling. Fixed runs use the native executor without internal model calls.
Saved data needs attention. The original data has been preserved: %1$s
No saved workflows. Create a workflow on this phone or import a shared package.
Imported without running. Bind and validate this version on your phone before enabling it.
Workflow exported. Local bindings and run records are not included.
The selected document cannot be read.
The selected location cannot be written.

Edit the structured definition, including declared inputs, steps and observable success conditions. Saving creates a disabled version; it does not run it. Use {{param.name}} and {{binding.name}} for declared values.
Version saved. Bind and validate it before enabling.
These values stay on this phone and are excluded from shared packages. Changing them invalidates previous validation.
Bindings saved. Validate this adaptation again before enabling it.
No input fields are declared for this section.
Checks this phone’s preparation path and stops before external effects. It does not publish or send content. An actual effect remains untested until an explicitly authorized task produces evidence.
Recorded business effects have been verified.
External business effects have not been tested.
This validation result covers the recorded preparation path. It does not mean a publish or send action succeeded.
Allow this task to perform the workflow’s declared publish, send or other external effects. Completed effects cannot be undone by stopping.
This task keeps the same request identity. Retrying or looking it up will not create another task. Choose a new task only for a separate intent.
The previous request is still retained. Look it up first, or explicitly start a new task for changed inputs.
No recorded task was found for this request on this phone. No new task was created by this lookup.
An earlier action may already have taken effect. Check the actual result before trying again; stopping preserves this uncertainty.
No action result has been recorded yet.
The saved workflow versions remain unchanged. Changes in this editor have not been saved.
Open an app and check text
Opens the app bound on this phone and checks for the supplied page text. Does not publish, send or analyze media.
Text that must be visible on the target page.
Exact package name of the app installed on this phone.
Open BKSOP on this phone before starting this workflow.
The phone control connection is unavailable. Check the helper connection on this phone.
Enable the accessibility service on this phone before running the workflow.
The phone control connection changed. Recheck the task on this phone before continuing.
Remote authorization for this workflow was revoked. Further actions have been stopped.
Unlock this phone and check the current page before continuing.
A workflow is running or waiting for your input. Open the app to view its actual progress.
Allow remote calls to this workflow
Authorized tools on the phone-owner connection may call this enabled workflow. Turning this off stops later actions of its remote tasks.
